changes.summary: Lens: a chart card returns to its grid size after the fullscreen panel is closed, instead of staying at the expanded height.

OIDC: serialize refresh token reuse revocation with rotation of the same grant (advisory lock) so a replacement committed during a revoke is revoked too; pykernel: a tool parameter named like a Python keyword no longer kills the kernel while it builds the tools namespace.
Remove unused Claude GitHub workflows, including the vulnerable claude-debugger workflow; CI configuration only, no runtime or public API change.
